in_english.name: Hazima
in_english.long_meaning: Hazima is a female Arabic name that symbolizes strength and determination. Derived from the root 'hazm', which means to hold firmly or to be strong. In Islamic tradition, this name is used to signify qualities of resilience and perseverance. Historically, it reflects the values of courage and steadfastness. The name Hazima is associated with positive personality traits such as being strong-willed and resolute.
